ns2:course.label: Meat Science
ns2:course.description: Fundamental biological principles that influence composition, processing, preservation, and quality of meat and meat products. Prerequisite: CHEM 104 and CHEM 105; MCB 100 and MCB 101, or MCB 300 and MCB 301.
